title: A Promotion on the Social Visuals Team
body_markdown:
Ragan Clark, who has transformed our weekend social visual coverage, is now a senior staff editor. Read more in the below note from editors Andrew Kueneman and Liz Pierson.


Building on her strong storytelling and deft news judgement, Ragan will now oversee our features and enterprise coverage off-platform, finding new ways to showcase our most in-depth, visually rich content. She will partner with the


Home, Audience, Photo, Video and Graphics teams


to find creative solutions to adapt the work for social and other parts of the off-platform report. Additionally, Ragan will serve as the Social Visuals liaison for desk-specific newsroom social accounts,


supporting the creation of high-quality visuals and the development of new formats


. Based in New York, she will move to a Monday-Friday schedule to collaborate more closely across visual teams.


Over the past four years, Ragan has transformed our weekend social visual coverage, using her photo editing and design expertise to bring the best of our visual journalism to our growing weekend audiences on social.


Whether navigating high-stakes breaking news (from


[the Trump assassination attempt](https://www.instagram.com/p/C9YV-ZKhaxs/) to the


[response to the immigration crackdown in Minneapolis](https://www.instagram.com/p/DT6B16rgdKE/) ) or crafting stunning live visual coverage for our biggest cultural tentpoles (


[the Olympics](https://www.instagram.com/p/DU--WI4El8I/) ,


[red carpets](https://www.instagram.com/p/DEeGMcAN_-k/) and


[award shows](https://www.instagram.com/p/DUPVoIWgchL/) ), she has consistently


found creative ways to showcase our best journalism


to a rapidly growing audience.


As the weekend social team grew, Ragan became a mentor, helping coach her colleagues on design, visual decision-making and best practices.


Previously, Ragan worked at the Associated Press as a social media producer and video producer. A Kentucky native, Ragan graduated from Belmont University before earning a master’s degree in digital asset and media management at King’s College London.


“Ragan has been a force on weekends, helping to make our accounts shine across platforms,” said Alexa Diaz, Audience’s editor for social media. “She has been an exceptional partner on breaking stories and signature enterprise, bringing a careful eye, steady hand and sharp news judgement to every visual edit. Beyond her skill, Ragan’s thoughtfulness makes her an editor we can all learn from.”


We’re excited to see Ragan take our visual storytelling to the next level.


Congratulations!


– Andrew and Liz
